Name: Luckier Mod
Author: newcoke2008
Description:
[b]Luciker Mod[/b] enhances your Stardew Valley gameplay by providing a clear and dynamic display of your daily luck status. Designed to integrate smoothly with the game's UI, this mod offers a visually pleasing experience that feels natural within the game world. The luck display is designed to disappear automatically at 11:00 AM to keep the screen uncluttered and enhance immersion.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic Luck Calculation:[/b] At the start of each day, Luciker Mod calculates your luck based on a custom algorithm, creating a unique twist in your gameplay. The luck values are randomly generated within specific ranges, ensuring a diverse and engaging experience every day.
[*][b]Visual Luck Indicator:[/b] The mod displays your daily luck as color-coded text on the screen:
[list]
[*][b]Purple:[/b] Exceptional luck (25% or higher).
[*][b]Green:[/b] Good luck (between 10% and 25%).
[*][b]Yellow:[/b] Moderate luck (between 0% and 10%).
[*][b]Orange:[/b] Bad luck (between -10% and 0%).
[*][b]Red:[/b] Very bad luck (below -10%).
[/list][*][b]Custom UI Background:[/b] To enhance readability and aesthetics, the luck indicator is set against a translucent, dark blue "billboard" style background, giving it a unique style that matches Stardew Valley's overall design.
[*][b]Timed Display:[/b] The luck display is visible from the start of the day and automatically disappears at 11:00 AM, keeping your screen clear and ensuring that the UI remains unobtrusive during gameplay.
[*][b]Optimized for Clarity:[/b] The mod’s UI dynamically adjusts to maintain clarity and visibility against all types of in-game environments, ensuring that the luck indicator is always easy to read.
[/list][b]Installation Instructions:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install SMAPI[/b]: Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], the mod loader for Stardew Valley.
[*][b]Download Luciker Mod[/b]: Get the latest release of Luciker Mod.
[*][b]Extract to Mods Folder[/b]: Unzip the downloaded file and place it into the [code]Mods[/code] folder within your Stardew Valley game directory.
[*][b]Launch with SMAPI[/b]: Start Stardew Valley using the SMAPI launcher to enable Luciker Mod.
[/list][b]How to Use:[/b]
Simply play Stardew Valley as usual. Luciker Mod will automatically display your daily luck on the right side of the screen, updating dynamically based on the custom luck calculation algorithm. The display will disappear at 11:00 AM each day, ensuring a clean and immersive gameplay experience.
